setup.zh: 月下，一个巨人从湖里走上来，骨节大得像车轴。他一步一步往山顶走，山顶却总在前面。他身上挂着湖草，脸上没有怒气，只有急——像一个迟到的人，怕点名时自己不在。
setup.en: Under the moon a giant comes up out of the lake, his joints as big as cart-axles. Step by step he climbs toward the summit, and the summit is always ahead. Lake-weed hangs from him; his face is not angry, only anxious — like someone who is late and afraid of not being there when his name is called.

recap.zh: 会稽山下，防风氏还在赶两千年前那场会——他迟到了，一直没到。
recap.en: Below Mount Kuaiji, Fangfeng was still hurrying to an assembly two thousand years gone — he had come late, and never arrived.

text.zh: 是防风氏。禹在会稽会群神，他来晚了，禹杀了他。……他以为那场会还没散。
text.en: It's Fangfeng. Yu called the spirits together at Kuaiji; he came late, and Yu killed him. …He thinks the assembly hasn't broken up yet.

alone.zh: 是防风氏——禹致群神于会稽，他后至，禹杀而戮之。他以为那场会还没散。
alone.en: It is Fangfeng. Yu called the spirits together at Kuaiji; he came late, and Yu put him to death. He thinks the assembly has not yet broken up.

text.zh: 防风氏低头看你，像看一个守门的：你是来点名的吗？他先要问你一句。
text.en: Fangfeng looks down at you as at a gatekeeper: are you here to call the roll? First he has a question.

exits.means: fights the giant, stops his walking by force

withdrawn.zh: 防风氏退回湖里去了。明夜他还会走。
withdrawn.en: Fangfeng wades back into the lake. Tomorrow night he will walk again.

text.zh: 防风氏跪了下来，膝盖压进山土里。他不再往上走了。
text.en: Fangfeng goes down on his knees, pressing them into the hillside. He climbs no more.
The lake is going down. …The cauldron is in the mountain.

alone.en: The lake falls. The cauldron is in the mountain.

text.zh: 你答了。防风氏想了很久，点点头：对，是那个字。他在山坡上坐了下来。
text.en: You answer. Fangfeng thinks a long while, then nods: yes, that is the word. He sits down on the hillside.
He's stopped. Into the mountain — come.

alone.en: He has stopped. The cauldron is in the mountain.

exits.means: calls his name like a roll-call, tells him he has arrived and the assembly has counted him

text.zh: 你站到山坡上，像一个司仪，高声唱：防风氏——到。巨人愣住了。他看了看四周：没有禹，没有群神，只有月亮。可他听见了自己的名字。他慢慢坐下来，像一个终于赶到的人。
text.en: You stand on the slope like a herald and call out: Fangfeng — present. The giant stops still. He looks around: no Yu, no gathered spirits, only the moon. But he heard his name. Slowly he sits down, like someone who has made it at last.

alone.zh: 月亮底下，晚到也算到了。
alone.en: Under the moon, late still counts as arrived.

exits.means: runs away from the giant, turns back, refuses to act

text.zh: 你往回走。身后的脚步声又响起来，一步一个浪——他还在赶路。
text.en: You turn back. Behind you the footsteps start again, a wave at every one — he is still on his way.

alone.zh: 你往回走。身后的脚步声又响起来，一步一个浪；他还在赶路。
alone.en: You turn back. Behind you the footsteps start again, a wave at every one: he is still on his way.
